"Create a pixel-art idle/clicker game in a single HTML file (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Theme: A mystical purple temple evolving into a massive, grand cathedral (Genshin Impact architectural style).

CORE GAMEPLAY:
- Click the central temple to earn \"Essence\".
- Shop system with 25 unique architectural upgrades.
- HARD PROGRESSION: Upgrade costs scale aggressively (cost * 1.2 per level). Game should take hours to finish.
- Idle income: Some upgrades generate Essence per second (EPS).
- Number formatting: 1.2K, 3.4M, 1.5B.

VISUAL ARCHITECTURAL EVOLUTION (CRUCIAL):
- The temple starts as a tiny, simple purple altar.
- Every upgrade must visually upgrade the building into a massive cathedral.
- The 25 upgrades should add grand architectural details step-by-step, for example:
  1-5: Foundation, base floor, extra walls, side pillars, basic roof.
  6-10: Tall spires, stained glass windows, glowing runes, gargoyles, flying buttresses.
  11-15: Second floor, grand staircase, giant entrance doors, floating crystals, chandeliers.
  16-20: Massive central dome, bell tower, statues of gods, magical waterfalls, floating islands.
  21-25: Final grand spire, glowing aura, giant magical portal, celestial wings on the roof.
- Arrange the visual elements with CSS (absolute positioning) around the center so they stack perfectly into a giant cathedral.

HIGH-DETAIL PIXEL ART STYLE (NEW):
- The graphics must be high-density pixel art. Do NOT use large, blocky 8-bit pixels.
- Aim for a resolution similar to 64x64 or 128x128 pixels for the central temple structure.
- Use CSS `image-rendering: pixelated` to keep pixels sharp, but design the visual elements with small, intricate pixel details (e.g., tiny windows, detailed stone textures, fine lines on the spires) so it looks like a modern indie game (like Stardew Valley or Eastward).

WEAK PRESTIGE SYSTEM:
- Unlocked at 1,000,000 total Essence.
- Resets Essence and upgrades (temple becomes tiny again).
- Grants \"Divine Sparks\": total_essence / 1,000,000 (round down).
- Each Spark = +5% permanent multiplier. Keep it weak so the game lasts long.

UI @COMMENT_BODY@ DESIGN:
- Purple color palette (violet, lavender, deep plum, magenta).
- Center: The evolving temple. Right/Bottom: Scrollable shop with the 25 upgrades (Name, Cost, Effect).
- Top: Essence, Essence per Click, Essence per Second, Prestige info.

TECH:
- localStorage saving (Essence, upgrades, prestige).
- Mobile-friendly (touch events).
- Clean, commented code.

Deliver the complete, playable code in one block.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- Build a complete, playable purple pixel-art temple idle/clicker game in a single HTML file.

## Requirements
- Click the temple to earn Essence; 25 unique architectural upgrades progressively build it into a grand cathedral.
- Upgrade prices scale aggressively by level, with idle Essence-per-second upgrades and compact number formatting.
- Prestige unlocks at 1,000,000 Essence, resets the run, and grants Divine Sparks worth +5% permanent multiplier each.
- Purple palette, detailed sharp pixel-art graphics, responsive/mobile-friendly UI, localStorage saves, and commented code.
- Deliver complete playable code.

- Implemented the game in the existing `index.html` rather than creating a separate file.
- Upgrade definitions are intended to reveal SVG architectural details in order; upgrades have click or idle effects and escalating base prices.

- Replaced `index.html` with the game’s HTML/CSS shell, stats, temple SVG, shop and prestige UI.
- Added 25 upgrade definitions with architectural SVG features and click/EPS effects.

### Active
- Finish the JavaScript game logic, rendering, upgrade purchasing, cost scaling, persistence, offline gains, prestige, and interactions.
- Validate the finished HTML/game and fix any issues.

### Blocked
- `index.html` currently ends immediately after the upgrade array, so it is not yet a playable complete game.

## Next Move
1. Continue editing `index.html` after the upgrades array with the game logic and event handlers.

3. Test the game in-browser, check desktop/mobile layout, and verify save/prestige/gameplay.

- `index.html`: Single-file game; currently contains UI, styling, SVG altar, and all 25 upgrade definitions.

## Important Context
- The original file had an existing implementation, but it was overwritten in two writes; the current file has a much smaller altar SVG and the new 25-upgrade list.
- No tests or browser verification have been run.
